sections.theory:
… are. Because of them tumours form in the body and they become the cause of high blood pressure. They make the liver and kidneys useless.

6. Beta blockers

These are generally used by patients of high blood pressure. In sports in which concentration is needed, e.g. shooting and archery etc., players use these. These reduce blood pressure and the heartbeat. These affect the reproductive system.

7. Diuretics

These are used in sports with weight categories. It is a urine-producing medicine. For boxing, karate and weight-lifting competitions they temporarily increase physical strength. These become the cause of decrease in the circulation of blood, muscular cramps, shortage of water in the body and diseases of the kidneys.

8. Alcohol

Its use too is prohibited in sports. It reduces white corpuscles. It makes the liver useless. It becomes the cause of decrease in balance and attention, because of which the intensity of injury and hard work is not felt.

9. Blood doping

Before training, players get blood taken out and preserved and get it put back before competitions, or transfer blood from some other person of their own blood group so that the number of red corpuscles increases. This is useful for long-distance runners. However it can become the cause of communicable diseases, e.g. hepatitis (B-C) and AIDS. It can also become the cause of allergy and heart attack.

ٹریننگ سے قبل کھلاڑی خون نکال کر محفوظ کروالیتے ہیں اور مقابلوں سے قبل دوبارہ لگوالیتے ہیں یا اپنے خون کے گروپ کے کسی دوسرے فرد سے خون منتقل کرتے ہیں تاکہ سرخ جسیموں کی تعداد بڑھ جائے۔ یہ لمبی دوڑ والے کھلاڑی کے لیے مفید ہوتا ہے۔ تاہم متعدی امراض مثلاً ہیپاٹائٹس (B-C) اور AIDS جیسے امراض کا باعث بنتی ہے۔ الرجی اور دل کے دورے کا سبب بھی بن سکتی ہے۔

issues.description: The numbering on this page runs 6, 7, 8 and then “7” again for blood doping (handwritten-looking print digits); the list on p.24 has blood doping as vii. Rendered 6–9 in sequence; noted. “یہ بلڈ پریشر … کو کم کرتا ہے”. Retained as printed otherwise.
